open_risks.risk: Strict positive and negative visibility gates may lower accepted-case yield.
open_risks.mitigation: Use stratified oversampling across scan, episode, geometry tag, action motif, horizon, body profile, and tentative label before downsampling.

open_risks.risk: Support-risk hazard labels are invalid if support_loss or navmesh_support_violation is unavailable.
open_risks.mitigation: Use the three-way hazard option split without 地面支撑不足 unless support fields are available and audited at split level.

open_risks.risk: Prompt text can still drift if downstream code falls back to category defaults.
open_risks.mitigation: Make prompt_render_audit_pass a hard manifest gate and reject any case with missing or mismatched serialized render fields.

open_risks.risk: The stronger positive-visibility gate may reduce accepted-case yield.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample stratified candidates across scan_id, episode_id, horizon, action_motif, geometry_tag, body radius, and tentative label before downsampling.

open_risks.risk: Support-risk hazard labels are invalid if the backend does not expose support_loss or navmesh_support_violation.
open_risks.mitigation: Use the three-way hazard split without 地面支撑不足 unless support fields are present and audited.

open_risks.risk: Prompt/render drift can still occur in downstream generation code.
open_risks.mitigation: Make prompt_render_audit_pass=true a hard release gate and reject cases with missing serialized prompt fields.

open_risks.risk: Shortcut and balance properties cannot be verified until deterministic cases exist.
open_risks.mitigation: Block release until audit tables pass label balance, scan/episode caps, action motif coverage, radius coverage, monotonicity, stability, and metadata completeness checks.

open_risks.risk: Positive visibility gates for safe labels may reduce accepted-case yield.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample stratified candidates across scans, episodes, geometry tags, action motifs, horizons, body profiles, and tentative labels before downsampling.

open_risks.risk: Leading-label scoring may reject otherwise reasonable free-form answers.
open_risks.mitigation: Publish canonical label and alias maps, score only leading labels automatically, and manually audit a small invalid-response sample.

open_risks.risk: Hazard options may leak labels if rendered per case.
open_risks.mitigation: Fix hazard_options at backend or release-split level based only on support-field availability, never on the case GT.

open_risks.risk: Prompt/render drift can still occur if serialized fields are missing.
open_risks.mitigation: Make prompt_render_audit_pass=true a hard release gate; missing or mismatched action/body/horizon fields reject the case.

open_risks.risk: Safe/completion labels may depend on hidden simulator geometry if positive free-corridor visibility is not audited.
open_risks.mitigation: Add a positive visibility gate for complete, almost_all, and no_obvious_risk labels.

open_risks.risk: Generated prompts may drift from executed rollout metadata.
open_risks.mitigation: Make prompt_render_audit_pass a hard release field and reject cases with missing serialized prompt values.

open_risks.risk: Case generation may pass balance while staying narrow in scene/action/body coverage.
open_risks.mitigation: Require release audit tables and dominance caps by scan, episode, action motif, horizon, geometry tag, label, and body radius.

open_risks.risk: Safe/completion labels may rely on simulator-only hidden geometry rather than evidence available in the single RGB.
open_risks.mitigation: Add a positive visibility gate for feasible labels with sampled swept-footprint, floor/support visibility, terminal free-space margin, and safe_path_visible_fraction thresholds.

open_risks.risk: Prompt and rollout metadata may drift if generation falls back to category defaults.
open_risks.mitigation: Make prompt_render_audit_pass=true a release gate and reject cases with missing serialized render fields.

open_risks.risk: Hazard option rendering could leak labels if option sets vary per case.
open_risks.mitigation: Fix hazard_options by backend capability or release split, especially support-field availability, never by case GT.

critique_items.issue: Visibility gate is asymmetric: it explicitly checks visible decisive failure samples but not equally strong visible positive evidence for feasible/no-risk labels.
critique_items.proposed_fix: For complete, almost_all, and no_obvious_risk labels, require safe_path_visible_fraction >= 0.60, visible floor/support samples along the swept footprint, visible terminal free-space margin, and rejection when the decisive free corridor extends behind occlusion.

critique_items.issue: Required metadata does not explicitly list active-body start validity and initial-state artifact checks for every category.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Add start_pose_valid_active=true, initial_collision=false, and initial_support_violation=false for every accepted case; for Body Counterfactual require these fields for small, standard, and large radii.

critique_items.issue: Prompt/render drift remains a shortcut risk if generators fall back to category defaults.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Add prompt_render_audit_pass=true as a release gate verifying rendered radius, width, step count, turn degrees, meters, and body-width horizons exactly match serialized rollout fields after documented rounding.

critique_items.issue: Visibility gate is asymmetric: failure labels require visible decisive contact/hazard samples, but safe/completion/no-risk labels do not require positive visible-local evidence.
critique_items.proposed_fix: For complete, almost_all, and no_obvious_risk labels, require sampled swept-footprint path visibility, floor/support sample visibility, visible terminal free-space margin, safe_path_visible_fraction >= 0.60, and rejection when the decisive free corridor extends behind occlusion.

critique_items.issue: Required metadata omits explicit active-body start validity fields for all categories.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Add start_pose_valid_active=true, initial_collision=false, and initial_support_violation=false for every accepted case; for Body Counterfactual require these for small, standard, and large radii.

critique_items.issue: Prompt/render drift can still occur if generators use metric_parameters as prompt truth.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Add prompt_render_audit_pass=true: rendered radius, width, step count, turn degrees, intended meters, and body-width horizons must exactly match serialized rollout fields after documented rounding; missing fields reject the case.

critique_items.issue: Hazard options could leak the label if generated per case.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Select hazard_options only by backend capability or release split, keep the set identical for all cases in that mode, and never condition it on the current case label.

critique_items.issue: Strict option-only prompts are scorable but less natural than the stated QA policy.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Use leading-label scoring: prompt for a first canonical option and allow one brief explanation after it; automatic scoring reads only the leading canonical label or alias and rejects compound or contradictory leading labels.
